mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM tc_outbox WHERE tenant_id>#{after} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_outbox_maintenance(tenant_id,next_round_at) VALUES(#{tenant},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tenant_id=tc_outbox_maintenance.tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT cursor_id,round_upper_id,round_active,scanned_count,candidate_count,(next_round_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS due FROM tc_outbox_maintenance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} FOR UPDATE
SELECT MAX(id) FROM tc_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
SELECT id,event_id,event_type,status FROM tc_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id>#{after} AND id<=#{upper} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_outbox_maintenance SET cursor_id=#{cursor},scanned_count=#{scanned},candidate_count=#{candidates}, round_active=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, completed_rounds=completed_rounds+CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, last_completed_at=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE last_completed_at END, last_upper_id=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN round_upper_id ELSE last_upper_id END, last_scanned_count=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN #{scanned} ELSE last_scanned_count END, last_candidate_count=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN #{candidates} ELSE last_candidate_count END, next_round_at=CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{intervalMicros},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE next_round_at END, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
